original_call2.prompt: These dashcam frames are ordered left to right, top to bottom. Which numbered frame first shows actual contact of the camera car with the other vehicle? Look for contact, not the later strongest shake. Allowed frames: [445, 446, 447, 448, 449, 588, 589, 590, 591, 592, 934, 1001, 1068, 1134, 1201]. Return JSON with collision_frame.

video.input_policy: native video TCHW; synthetic2fps playback, not source/capture FPS
video.synthetic_prefix: Frames are ordered chronologically. The playback timestamps are synthetic and do not represent physical capture time; answer using the original frame numbers printed on the images.
video.temporal_padding_policy: processor repeats last frame once for oddK; no offered candidate discarded
video.comparison_limit: Spatial resize, pixel/token counts, synthetic timestamps and temporal patching differ from earlier sheet/multi-image. Not a pure packing comparison.
video.peak_scope: Peak counters reset for this call after CPU processing; includes resident model. Aggregate all call peaks for run peak.
